text:
irene: heads up — noticed a tenant in eu-west silently getting routed to v1 during a regional capacity pressure event. console shows quota burn for v2 unchanged but latency regressions in eu-west app logs. link: https://console/redwood/tenants/rc-42 :eyes:
sahil: hmm that sounds like the fallback path where region-unavailable -> cross-region fallback to older variant. did the routing proxy emit a fallback tag?
irene: proxy emits route.variant=fallback but our console aggregations only count requests by "served_model" and region. so we missed that some v2 traffic was actually being served by v1 replicas in us-central.
matt: rough. that explains the mismatch between token billing and tenant p50/p95 in the dashboard. billing counted served_model=v1 while console per-route latency showed v2 because of cached metadata.
anya: can we add a telemetry dimension route.fallback_reason + origin_region so we can correlate "request came from eu-west" vs "served from us-central-v1"? currently we only emit fallback_reason as a log line.
kevin: +1. also propose adding tenant-level quantiles (p50/p95/p99) for "served_model_latency" and "server_region" tag in the per-tenant dashboard. that'll surface cross-region degradation quickly.
irene: agree. two asks: 1) make routing proxy emit fallback_reason and origin_region as structured trace/span attributes, 2) add a console visualization that shows mismatch between requested_model vs served_model and heatmap of origin_region -> serve_region.
console-bot: deploy-bot: can runbook check for "served_model != requested_model" anomalies and create incident if >0.5% traffic in 5m window.
sahil: implementation note: adding new telemetry fields will increase cardinality. we should map origin_region -> coarse bucket (local, cross-region) to avoid high-cardinality for multi-az names. also add tenant sampling for full tag combos.
matt: for dashboard UX: create a stacked bar where X axis is time, bars split by requested_model (v2/v1) but with hatch pattern for served_model!=requested_model, and a parallel quantile line for p95.
anya: we should also surface quota attribution differences: if billing backend uses served_model to attribute quota, tenants will see unexpected token usage. need a reconciliation job that compares request headers -> billing events to find attribution diffs.
kevin: propose a temporary console banner for affected tenants: "We've detected cross-region fallback for some requests which may affect latency and quota attribution. Contact support if you see billing surprises." allow opt-out?
irene: discussion item: do we automatically hide fallback behind a grace/consent flag in SDKs? i.e., have SDK send header "allow_cross_region_fallback=true". default off for newer SDKs so customers opt-in. that avoids silent surprises.
sahil: SDK consent header is good. but we need a migration plan: 1) produce telemetry for silent fallbacks, 2) surface banner + notify heavy users, 3) gate automatic fallback behind header in 30 days.
matt: operational runbook snippet: if served_model!=requested_model spikes, check 1) capacity metrics in region, 2) eviction logs, 3) routing policy changes in last 10m. quick query: ```sql
SELECT
  tenant_id,
  origin_region,
  served_model,
  requested_model,
  count(*) AS requests
FROM routing_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant_id, origin_region, served_model, requested_model
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
anya: love that. also add alert that triggers on quantified token-attribution delta: ```sql
SELECT tenant_id, sum(billed_tokens) as billed, sum(served_tokens) as served
FROM billing_events JOIN routing_events USING(request_id)
WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY tenant_id
HAVING abs(billed - served) / NULLIF(GREATEST(billed, served),0) > 0.02;
```
kevin: small UI question: how do we show consent header state? display per-tenant SDK config in the console config tab with states: opt-in, opt-out, unknown. allow customer to toggle with explanation modal.
irene: timeline suggestion: telemetry fields + dashboard heatmap (week 1), reconciliation job + alerts (week 2), banner + notifications (week 3), SDK header enforcement (week 5).
sahil: I'll spin up a telemetry PR. will add coarse origin_region buckets and a sampling knob. matt/anya can you mock the dashboard widget?
matt: will do a prototype in Looker Monday.
anya: I'll draft the reconciliation job and the alert rules.
kevin: I'll write the banner copy and console config toggle + support doc.
ire ne: thanks all — let's sync in the eng-platform weekly for rollout approval. :thumbsup:
